integrity: The Hom-Lie identities and Nijenhuis equations are reconstructed from the displayed brackets. The universal block factorization is symbolic; finite-field enumeration over split and nonsplit representatives is used only as replay evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the nondegenerate multiplicative subfamily a=d=0 and beta*gamma nonzero inside the three-dimensional source example.
The finite-field square-class classification assumes odd characteristic.
The degenerate fibers beta*gamma=0 are not classified.
The complete text of the 2021 general Nijenhuis paper was not available through the public sources inspected.
title: Square-class bifurcation of Nijenhuis operators in a three-dimensional Hom–Lie family
